Asset.name: Fryer VB Series Vertical Machining Center (FANUC 0i-MF control)
Asset.description: CNC vertical machining center with FANUC 0i-MF control.

Component.name: Absolute Encoder
Component.description: Battery backed up absolute encoder on X, Y and Z axes.

Component.name: Ballscrew and Linear Guide Rails
Component.description: Axis drive ballscrew and linear guides.

Symptom.name: Machine home position is lost
Symptom.description: The machine home position is lost after an absolute encoder alarm.

Symptom.name: Loss of motion in the axis
Symptom.description: Measured backlash shows loss of motion in the axis.

FailureMode.name: ATC carousel miscount
FailureMode.description: The ATC carousel position count is wrong.

FailureMode.name: Battery for the absolute encoder goes dead
FailureMode.description: The absolute encoder battery is dead or the encoder is disconnected, losing position tracking.

FailureMode.name: Backlash in ballscrew and linear guide rails
FailureMode.description: Backlash from the ballscrew and linear guide rails is out of specification.

CorrectiveAction.name: Execute M61 to home the ATC carousel
CorrectiveAction.description: Run M61 to restore the ATC carousel count and home it to pocket 1 (assumes tool 0 in spindle).
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Run M61 to restore the ATC carousel count and home it to pocket 1 (assumes tool 0 in spindle).
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Fryer VB Series FANUC 0i-MF CNC Maintenance Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Reference the axis
CorrectiveAction.description: Reset the home position and reference the axis: set parameter 1815 APZ bit to 0, power down, jog the axis to the alignment marks, set the APZ bit to 1 and power down again.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Reset the home position and reference the axis: set parameter 1815 APZ bit to 0, power down, jog the axis to the alignment marks, set the APZ bit to 1 and power down again.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Fryer VB Series FANUC 0i-MF CNC Maintenance Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Adjust backlash compensation
CorrectiveAction.description: Adjust backlash compensation according to the procedure in Section 3.33.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Adjust backlash compensation according to the procedure in Section 3.33.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Fryer VB Series FANUC 0i-MF CNC Maintenance Manual
